evidence_items.explanation: The researcher reports more than 30 vulnerabilities and 24 assigned CVEs across multiple coding products. This supports the existence of numerous attack paths, but the selected test set does not represent every product or establish a thousand-patch threshold.

The follow-up reports new extension-based attack paths after nearly 30 vulnerabilities were patched across 12 vendors. It supports recurring vulnerabilities after remediation, while the successful earlier patching is material evidence that particular attacks can be stopped.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved record tests the assertion about a thousand patches or defines a comparable patch count.
Controlled demonstrations do not establish how many malicious attacks succeeded in deployed systems.
No decisive event establishes either permanent inadequacy of remediation or a general solution across the claimed scope.
